name: trellis
description: Local image-to-print. Trellis.2 on your ComfyUI GPU turns one photo into a GLB. The Hermes machine writes a checked binary STL. No cloud API, no subscription, no rigging, no animation.

comfy_url.label: ComfyUI URL
comfy_url.description: Base URL of ComfyUI on the GPU machine, for example http://<DGX-TAILNET-IP>:8188.

python.label: Python for STL
python.description: Interpreter with trimesh and fast-simplification. Empty uses python3 on PATH.

out_dir.label: Output folder
out_dir.description: Where GLBs, STLs, and provenance.json are written when a tool call omits a path.
